verses.text: A song of ascents. From down in the depths I cry out to you, LORD.
Lord, hear my voice. Listen closely when I beg for help.
LORD, if you kept track of every sin, who could stand before you?
But you forgive, and that’s why we stand in awe of you.
I’m waiting for the LORD with my whole soul. I put my hope in what he says.
I long for the Lord more than guards long for morning, more than guards long for morning.
Israel, put your hope in the LORD. Faithful love is with him, and he has more than enough power to redeem.
He’ll redeem Israel from all their sins.
